name: Each news card is a clickable link to the source article
description: News cards should be clickable links that lead to the original source article URL. Cards that are purely decorative with no link fail this test.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket match cell to open a match detail page

Verify the first news card contains a clickable anchor element (either wrapping the card or shown as a 'Read more' link) that points to a URL starting with https://. The link should lead to an external news source, not the app's own pages.
